info.title: API.SH: Feedly
info.description: The Feedly API from API.SH: public Feedly data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:
The latest entries of a feed (or the oldest Feedly keeps with `ranked=oldest`): id, title, link, author, published/crawled dates, summary, full content as HTML and text, keywords, engagement, image and source feed. Feedly serves up to 50 entries per feed without an account, so this route has no paging; use `newer_than` to fetch only what is new since your last call.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/feedly-entries

parameters.name: feed
parameters.description: The feed: its RSS/Atom URL (e.g. `https://www.theverge.com/rss/index.xml`), a bare host, or a Feedly feed id (`feed/https://...`) from search.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Entries to return (1-30, default 20).

parameters.name: ranked
parameters.description: `newest` (default) or `oldest`.

parameters.name: newer_than
parameters.description: Only entries newer than this ISO date or epoch milliseconds.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: `full` (default) includes the article body as HTML and text; `none` leaves it out.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Find feeds by keyword, site name, domain, feed URL or `#topic`: feed id and URL, title, website, description, language, follower count, velocity (articles per week), topics, state, last update and images, best match first. One page of up to 100 results (no paging).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/feedly-search

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Keyword, site name, domain, feed URL or `#topic`, e.g. `technology` or `#tech`.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Results to return (1-100, default 20).

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language/region of the results, e.g. `en`, `fr`, `pt-BR`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The most engaging recent entries of a feed or of a topic (Feedly's own engagement ranking): the same entry fields as `/feedly/v1/entries`, with engagement counts. Pass `feed` or `topic`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/feedly-top-entries

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: A Feedly topic, e.g. `tech`, `marketing`, `cybersecurity` (see `/feedly/v1/topics`). Pass this or `feed`.

parameters.name: feed
parameters.description: A feed URL or Feedly feed id instead of a topic.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Entries to return (1-30, default 20).

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Only entries from the last N hours (up to 720).

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language/region of the results, e.g. `en`, `fr`, `pt-BR`. Default `en` for topics.

parameters.name: backfill
parameters.description: `true` fills a short window with older popular entries.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: `full` (default) or `none` (no article body).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Feedly's topic directory in alphabetical pages of about 100 topics: topic id, name, image and the top feed of each topic. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/feedly-topics

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
